resources.string: Blanked uses this service to detect when a protected app opens and show the blocking screen.
Your phone is taking more of your life than you think
Blanked helps you block distractions and build healthier screen habits.
NFC is optional. Blanked can work as a software-only blocker.
NFC is not available on this device. You can still use Blanked without it.
Try again later from settings if you want to link a physical Blank.
Enable NFC in Android settings if you want to link a physical Blank.
Hold your NFC tag near the back of the phone.
Enable Accessibility so Blanked can detect protected apps. Battery permission helps keep blocks stable in the background.
Tap here and enable Blanked in Accessibility. If Android shows restricted settings, open App info, the three-dot menu, and allow restricted settings.
Let Android keep Blanked available in the background so blocking stays active.
Accessibility is required to know when you open a protected app. Open Settings, enable Blanked, and return to continue.
Battery optimization can stop background blocking. Open Settings, allow Blanked to keep running, and try again.
Blanked is set up. Start your first block when you are ready.
Use Emergency if you genuinely need access now.
Choose the apps that usually pull you away from what matters.
NFC was not detected. You can still use manual blocking.
This week Blanked protected you %1$d times.
Hold a new NFC tag near the back of the phone. Your protected apps stay saved.
Your new NFC tag is linked. Your protected apps stay the same.
Blanked uses Android Accessibility events to know when the foreground app changes. If that app is protected and Blanked is active, Blanked opens the blocking screen.
Blanked checks app package names from window-change events. It does not read screen contents, typed text, passwords, notifications, contacts, messages, browsing history, or media files.
Blanked stores selected protected apps, setup state, active block state, and session history on this device. Exact app selections stay local unless a future version asks for explicit consent.
Blanked is doing its job. Return to what you meant to do.
You have stayed away from this app. Keep going.
This turns Blanked off. To keep friction, type the exact phrase before continuing.
I want to turn Blanked off now
Blanked is off. Start another block when you are ready.
NFC is not available on this device
Choose at least one app to block.
